description: She wears a dark blue opaque square-neck fitted court gown with elbow sleeves, gold woven borders, decorated shoulder brooches and an ornate woven belt with round clasp. Cream linen shows below the overskirt. A cream wool shawl with blue-gold patterned edging rests along the arms; pendant, drop earrings and brown leather shoes are visible. No headgear, armor or weapons.
